belongings_photo_check.name: belongings_photo_check
belongings_photo_check.value:
("belongings"."photo_key" is null and "belongings"."photo_type" is null)
				or ("belongings"."photo_key" is not null and "belongings"."photo_type" in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'))

belongings_content_check.name: belongings_content_check
belongings_content_check.value:
("belongings"."deleted_at" is null and "belongings"."name" is not null and "belongings"."purchase_price_minor" is not null
				and "belongings"."purchase_price_minor" >= 0 and "belongings"."purchased_on" is not null and "belongings"."created_at" is not null
				and ("belongings"."current_value_minor" is null or "belongings"."current_value_minor" >= 0))
			or ("belongings"."deleted_at" is not null and "belongings"."name" is null and "belongings"."purchase_price_minor" is null
				and "belongings"."purchased_on" is null and "belongings"."current_value_minor" is null and "belongings"."photo_key" is null
				and "belongings"."photo_type" is null and "belongings"."note" is null and "belongings"."created_at" is null)

budgets_amount_check.name: budgets_amount_check
budgets_amount_check.value: ("budgets"."deleted_at" is null and "budgets"."amount_minor" > 0) or ("budgets"."deleted_at" is not null and "budgets"."amount_minor" = 0)

connected_apps_content_check.name: connected_apps_content_check
connected_apps_content_check.value:
("connected_apps"."deleted_at" is null and "connected_apps"."status" = 'connected'
				and ("connected_apps"."external_label" is null or length("connected_apps"."external_label") between 1 and 80)
				and ("connected_apps"."scope" is null or length("connected_apps"."scope") between 1 and 500)
				and (("connected_apps"."encrypted_token" is null and "connected_apps"."token_nonce" is null and "connected_apps"."token_key_id" is null)
					or ("connected_apps"."encrypted_token" is not null and length("connected_apps"."encrypted_token") <= 12000
						and "connected_apps"."token_nonce" is not null and length("connected_apps"."token_nonce") = 16
						and "connected_apps"."token_key_id" is not null and length("connected_apps"."token_key_id") = 11)))
			or ("connected_apps"."deleted_at" is not null and "connected_apps"."status" = 'disconnected' and "connected_apps"."external_label" is null
				and "connected_apps"."encrypted_token" is null and "connected_apps"."token_nonce" is null and "connected_apps"."token_key_id" is null
				and "connected_apps"."scope" is null)

drafts_saved_check.name: drafts_saved_check
drafts_saved_check.value: "drafts"."saved_transaction_id" is null or "drafts"."deleted_at" is not null

drafts_content_check.name: drafts_content_check
drafts_content_check.value: ("drafts"."deleted_at" is null and "drafts"."amount_minor" is not null and "drafts"."amount_minor" between 1 and 10000000000000 and "drafts"."currency" is not null and "drafts"."occurred_on" is not null and "drafts"."occurred_at" is not null) or ("drafts"."deleted_at" is not null and "drafts"."amount_minor" is null and "drafts"."currency" is null and "drafts"."title" is null and "drafts"."note" is null and "drafts"."category_id" is null and "drafts"."wallet_id" is null and "drafts"."occurred_on" is null and "drafts"."occurred_at" is null and "drafts"."flag" is null)

goal_contributions_content_check.name: goal_contributions_content_check
goal_contributions_content_check.value:
("goal_contributions"."deleted_at" is null and "goal_contributions"."amount_minor" is not null and "goal_contributions"."amount_minor" > 0
				and "goal_contributions"."created_at" is not null)
			or ("goal_contributions"."deleted_at" is not null and "goal_contributions"."amount_minor" is null and "goal_contributions"."note" is null
				and "goal_contributions"."created_by_user_id" is null and "goal_contributions"."created_at" is null)

net_worth_items_content_check.name: net_worth_items_content_check
net_worth_items_content_check.value:
("net_worth_items"."deleted_at" is null and "net_worth_items"."kind" in ('cash', 'investment_stock', 'investment_crypto', 'investment_gold', 'property', 'vehicle', 'debt', 'other_asset')
				and "net_worth_items"."name" is not null and "net_worth_items"."currency" is not null and "net_worth_items"."created_at" is not null
				and "net_worth_items"."price_source" in ('manual', 'indodax', 'gold_api')
				and ("net_worth_items"."manual_value_minor" is null or "net_worth_items"."manual_value_minor" between 1 and 10000000000000)
				and ("net_worth_items"."price_source" <> 'manual' or ("net_worth_items"."manual_value_minor" is not null and "net_worth_items"."price_symbol" is null))
				and ("net_worth_items"."price_source" <> 'indodax' or ("net_worth_items"."kind" = 'investment_crypto' and "net_worth_items"."currency" = 'IDR' and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" is not null
					and "net_worth_items"."price_symbol" is not null and length("net_worth_items"."price_symbol") between 1 and 15 and "net_worth_items"."price_symbol" not glob '*[^a-z0-9]*'))
				and ("net_worth_items"."price_source" <> 'gold_api' or ("net_worth_items"."kind" = 'investment_gold' and "net_worth_items"."currency" = 'IDR' and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" is not null and "net_worth_items"."price_symbol" is null))
				and (("net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" is null and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scale" is null)
					or ("net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" not glob '*[^0-9]*' and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" not glob '0*' and length("net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled") between 1 and 24
						and (("net_worth_items"."kind" = 'investment_crypto' and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scale" = 8) or ("net_worth_items"."kind" = 'investment_gold' and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scale" = 3))))
				and ("net_worth_items"."acquired_on" is null or length("net_worth_items"."acquired_on") = 10))
			or ("net_worth_items"."deleted_at" is not null and "net_worth_items"."kind" is null and "net_worth_items"."name" is null and "net_worth_items"."currency" is null and "net_worth_items"."price_source" is null
				and "net_worth_items"."price_symbol" is null and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scaled" is null and "net_worth_items"."quantity_scale" is null and "net_worth_items"."manual_value_minor" is null
				and "net_worth_items"."acquired_on" is null and "net_worth_items"."note" is null and "net_worth_items"."created_at" is null)

net_worth_snapshots_total_check.name: net_worth_snapshots_total_check
net_worth_snapshots_total_check.value:
("net_worth_snapshots"."deleted_at" is null and "net_worth_snapshots"."total_minor" is not null and abs("net_worth_snapshots"."total_minor") <= 9007199254740991 and length("net_worth_snapshots"."date") = 10)
			or ("net_worth_snapshots"."deleted_at" is not null and "net_worth_snapshots"."total_minor" is null)

push_subscriptions_tombstone_check.name: push_subscriptions_tombstone_check
push_subscriptions_tombstone_check.value: "push_subscriptions"."deleted_at" is null or ("push_subscriptions"."p256dh" = '' and "push_subscriptions"."auth" = '' and "push_subscriptions"."user_agent" is null)

space_notifications_content_check.name: space_notifications_content_check
space_notifications_content_check.value: ("space_notifications"."deleted_at" is null and "space_notifications"."params" is not null) or ("space_notifications"."deleted_at" is not null and "space_notifications"."params" is null and "space_notifications"."read_at" is null)

subscriptions_content_check.name: subscriptions_content_check
subscriptions_content_check.value:
("subscriptions"."deleted_at" is null and "subscriptions"."name" is not null and "subscriptions"."category" is not null
				and "subscriptions"."amount_minor" is not null and "subscriptions"."amount_minor" > 0 and "subscriptions"."currency" is not null
				and "subscriptions"."next_charge_on" is not null and "subscriptions"."reminder_days_before" between 0 and 14
				and (("subscriptions"."billing_cycle" = 'monthly' and "subscriptions"."billing_day" between 1 and 31 and "subscriptions"."billing_month" is null)
					or ("subscriptions"."billing_cycle" = 'weekly' and "subscriptions"."billing_day" between 1 and 7 and "subscriptions"."billing_month" is null)
					or ("subscriptions"."billing_cycle" = 'yearly' and "subscriptions"."billing_month" between 1 and 12
						and "subscriptions"."billing_day" between 1 and 31)))
			or ("subscriptions"."deleted_at" is not null and "subscriptions"."catalogue_id" is null and "subscriptions"."name" is null
				and "subscriptions"."category" is null and "subscriptions"."amount_minor" is null and "subscriptions"."currency" is null
				and "subscriptions"."billing_cycle" is null and "subscriptions"."billing_day" is null and "subscriptions"."billing_month" is null
				and "subscriptions"."wallet_id" is null and "subscriptions"."linked_transaction_id" is null and "subscriptions"."next_charge_on" is null
				and "subscriptions"."reminder_days_before" is null)

transactions_content_check.name: transactions_content_check
transactions_content_check.value: ("transactions"."deleted_at" is null and "transactions"."amount_minor" is not null and "transactions"."amount_minor" between 1 and 10000000000000 and "transactions"."currency" is not null and "transactions"."wallet_id" is not null and "transactions"."occurred_on" is not null and "transactions"."occurred_at" is not null and ("transactions"."type" = 'transfer') = ("transactions"."transfer_to_wallet_id" is not null) and ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' or "transactions"."category_id" is null) and ("transactions"."transfer_to_wallet_id" is null or "transactions"."transfer_to_wallet_id" <> "transactions"."wallet_id")) or ("transactions"."deleted_at" is not null and "transactions"."amount_minor" is null and "transactions"."currency" is null and "transactions"."wallet_id" is null and "transactions"."transfer_to_wallet_id" is null and "transactions"."category_id" is null and "transactions"."occurred_on" is null and "transactions"."occurred_at" is null and "transactions"."title" is null and "transactions"."note" is null)

user_notifications_content_check.name: user_notifications_content_check
user_notifications_content_check.value: ("user_notifications"."deleted_at" is null and "user_notifications"."params" is not null) or ("user_notifications"."deleted_at" is not null and "user_notifications"."params" is null and "user_notifications"."read_at" is null)

wallets_last_four_check.name: wallets_last_four_check
wallets_last_four_check.value: "wallets"."last_four" is null or (length("wallets"."last_four") = 4 and "wallets"."last_four" not glob '*[^0-9]*')
